title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water until al dente.
Cook bacon until crisp, then reduce heat.
Whisk eggs with parmesan and pepper in a bowl.
Toss pasta with bacon (off heat), then quickly mix in egg-cheese sauce.
Serve immediately with extra parmesan and pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Grilled chicken pieces cooked in a creamy tomato-based sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices for at least 30 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear chicken until browned.
Sauté onion until golden, add tomato puree and simmer.
Add cream and chicken; simmer until cooked through.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Quick, healthy toast topped with mashed avocado and seasonings.
steps: Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt.
Top with chili flakes if desired.
